rows.text: Growing weary of the daily monotony of memory cremation work, Cremator Rama created the memoria bugs. These minuscule memoria creatures could consume memoria to multiply and clone themselves. Within a system day, they transformed the trade planet Uro completely, turning it into what was known to all as the "lost world." While the Garden of Recollection managed to exterminate most of the memoria bugs in time, the escaped clusters became a biological catastrophe rivaling the vicious silicone-eating bacteria. As for Cremator Rama, before he was devoured down to his marrow, he finally experienced the automated engineering that he longed for.
